The condition that each element in $I$ must appear infinitely often in a sequence is $(i_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}\subseteq I$ is generalized in the following definition.
\begin{definition}[Admissible sequences]
Let $I$ and $I^*$ be nonempty finite sets with $I^*\subseteq I$. A sequence $(i_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}\subseteq I$ is \emph{admissible in $I^*$} if every element of $I^*$ appears  infinitely often in $(i_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$.
\end{definition}
